rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something throws a situation into confusion or disorder.

example.english: This heavy rain can disrupt our whole itinerary.
example.traditional: 呢場大雨搞亂晒我哋成個行程。
example.jyutping: nei1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 gaau2 lyun6 saai3 ngo5 dei6 sing4 go3 haang4 cing4

rows.note: Use this when an action, speech, or activity is interrupted before it can continue normally.

example.jyutping: m4 hou2 daa2 dyun6 ngo5 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this when disrupting means hindering or obstructing, especially when progress is blocked rather than someone being verbally interrupted.

example.english: That car can disrupt traffic by blocking the road.
example.traditional: 架車泊喺度阻住晒條路。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 paak3 hai2 dou6 zo2 zyu6 saai3 tiu4 lou6

rows.note: Use this in business or technology contexts when a new product or service overturns an established market order.

example.english: This new platform could disrupt the entire retail market.
example.traditional: 呢個新平台有機會顛覆成個零售市場。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 san1 ping4 toi4 jau5 gei1 wui6 din1 fuk1 sing4 go3 ling4 sau6 si5 coeng4
